thread:
sam: Noticed a tiny but consistent delta in preview for a handful of tenants after yesterday's routing change. Mostly EU.

hema: Can you share numbers?

sam: ~0.35% token bump for 12 tenants. Traced to events duplicated across route_resolution_id when our graceful handoff broadcasts a mirror.

omar: I thought we deduped by request_id at ingest?

sam: We do, but mirror writes currently set `billable=true` on both copies for safety. Downstream join by (tenant, route) treats them separate in preview.

ryan: Quick mitigation: make mirror writes `billable=false` for 1h canary. Low-risk toggle in proxy.

hema: Also add a dashboard card: duplicate-by-route ratio per-tenant. Use metric `metering_route_mirror_ratio`.

sam: I'll open the proxy toggle PR and add the dashboard patch.

omar: Medium-term: change mirror semantics to non-billable or include `canonical_request_id` label and let ingest dedupe prefer canonical.

billing-bot: alert: preview-mirror-dup-rate tenant_count=12 pct_avg=0.35% severity=low

hema: action items: proxy toggle (ryan, 30m), dashboard card (sam, 45m), RFC for mirror semantics (om + infra, next sprint).

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4301 running canary now. Will report results.
